startHere.heading: YouTube Niche Breakout Finder
startHere.subtitle: Google Sheets companion for the n8n YouTube niche breakout workflow
startHere.whatItDoes: Every week the workflow searches YouTube for your niche phrases, scores each recent video by views per day against the other new videos in the same search, and saves the breakouts here, one row per video. Reruns skip videos that are already in the sheet, so each breakout appears once, and Slack gets one digest grouped into topic angles.
checklist: Make your own copy of this spreadsheet before connecting it to n8n.
Connect Google Sheets OAuth in n8n and select your copy in both Google Sheets nodes (Read Logged Video IDs and 4. Log Breakouts to Google Sheets).
Keep the Breakouts tab and every header in row 1 unchanged. Video ID is the match key.
Connect Apify, OpenAI and Slack, edit your niche searches in node 1, then run the workflow once by hand.
Publish the workflow to turn on the Monday 9:00 schedule.

startHere.dataNote: The rows in Breakouts are public demonstration data from a QA run on 12 Nov 2026. Delete the data rows before production if you want a blank sheet; keep row 1.
